thread:
incident-bot: Pager opened: billing/usage-anomaly detected — token counts from emitter-A are +32% vs expected over last 30m. Triage tag: P1.
emma (sre): oncall?
ravi (oncall): i'm on it, joining huddle. quick check: is this across regions or single region?
olivia (billing-eng): seeing spike in the token-aggregate compare window: seq window 5m shows drift starting 04:12 UTC. emitter-A has duplicate ack pattern in logs.
mike (support): customers already getting overage emails; a few tickets opened.
ravi (oncall): ok i'll try to pause emitter replica to stop duplicates. proposing: `kubectl scale deploy/emitter-a --replicas=0` then investigate consumer side. anyone object?
emma (sre): +1 do it. also set ingestion to shadow mode: `service-ingest --shadow=true` while we triage.
olivia (billing-eng): running quick SQL to snapshot counts: `SELECT source, count(*) FROM tokens WHERE ts > now()-interval '1 hour' GROUP BY source;` emitter-a shows ~1.31x vs emitter-b.
ravi (oncall): scaled emitter-a to 0. Confirmed process termination—logs show repeated commit/retry loop in consumer client.
olivia (billing-eng): looks like consumer backpressure + retry without idempotency caused duplicates. pushing a small consumer patch to dedupe by `msg_id`.
emma (sre): can we mute billing alerting/overage notifications while we triage? don't want to flood customers/security.
kate (pm): list of customers with active overage flags posted to #support-private. we should prepare temp credits and a short status page blurb.
mike (support): i've messaged affected customers: "We're investigating possible duplicate usage counts; if you see an overage flag we'll review and credit if necessary." keeping tone conservative.
olivia (billing-eng): deployed dedupe patch to consumer (v2.3.7-dedupe) to staging, running reingest dry-run.
ravi (oncall): re-enabled emitter at 1 replica with dedupe in place, watching metrics.
incident-bot: metric check: token-agg-diff dropped from +32% to +3% in 12m after stop+patch.
emma (sre): start reconcile job for last 6 hours to compute deltas and affected accounts: `jobs/reconcile --since 6h --output s3://redwood-deltas/1726004321.csv`
olivia (billing-eng): reconcile job started. ETA ~18m.
mike (support): holding off credits until reconcile output. what's immediate customer impact estimate?
olivia (billing-eng): preliminary: ~60 customers with transient +up-to-18% extra tokens; only 4 triggered billing alert thresholds. final reconcile will confirm.
kate (pm): drafting status.redwood.ai update: "We observed a metering duplication event impacting a subset of customers. We're triaging and will issue credits as needed. Next update in 30m."
ravi (oncall): after reconcile, we should run corrective backfill and mark impacted invoices. finance approval required for credits.
emma (sre): action items for postmortem: tighten retry/backoff, add dedupe key enforcement, add canary and alert for emitter-consumer divergence. tagging owners.
olivia (billing-eng): reconcile finished — summary: "delta_csv: s3://redwood-deltas/1726004321.csv — total overcount tokens: 1,234,567 — affected customers: 62 — estimated billing impact: $1,450 USD"
mike (support): submitting credit requests for the 62 customers now. will attach reconcile CSV.
incident-bot: Incident RESOLVED — root cause: consumer retry loop without idempotency key leading to duplicate token commits. Mitigation: scaled emitter, patched consumer dedupe, reconciled counts, issued credits. Postmortem scheduled.
ravi (oncall): handing off to emma for postmortem writeup and follow-ups. i'll stay available for 15m to watch rollout.
emma (sre): taking it. will open postmortem doc, include detection timelines and action items, and link this thread. thanks team :heart:
